author: Eileen K
content: We ordered the violet package plus ball pool and 4 little hoppers for my son's first birthday yesterday. It would not be an exaggeration to say that Dancing Cubs' great play equipment made our party a huge success - parents and children alike all loved it, even older children - and the baby guests cried when it was time to leave as they were having too much fun on the soft play! Lopez is great - responsive, helpful and flexible. We will recommend Dancing cubs to our friends and look forward to booking again in the future!
